tr.title: Vitrin penceresi
tr.subtitle: Mesaj · 23:11
tr.body:
Bir tanıdık yazdı: *"Yarın Vitrin'de çıksana, sana destek olurum."*

Görünürlük demek — bir günlüğüne herkes bakar. Kötü giderse, o da herkesin önünde olur.

en.title: A window in the shop front
en.subtitle: Message · 23:11
en.body:
Someone you know wrote: *"Why not launch on Vitrin tomorrow, I will back you."*

It means visibility — for one day everybody looks. If it goes badly, that is in front of everybody too.

_repair_note: the modifier value and the old card id both named a live trademark; the player-facing copy already used the canon fictional analogue
_r8a_note: A non-critical interrupt is demotable (§13.2), and a demoted card lands on the desk with a clock — which is the only reason paper is a safe floor for I4. So it carries the paper trio even though it usually renders as an interrupt.
_port_note: The old id and the "source" modifier value both named a live trademark; the player-facing copy already used the canon fictional analogue, Vitrin. GDD v2 ch.14 §6 lists real trademarks under "Cut / never", so this is a release blocker closed, not a rename for taste. SCOPE ADDED. Every customer-scoped effect on this card resolved to NOTHING: the old executor's default target was `get_lowest_satisfaction_customer(<event's market>)`, computed at apply time, and the port carried the effects across without carrying the default. A required slot says the same thing in the vocabulary that can also refuse the card when there is nobody to be about — which the old default could not do; it silently no-opped and the player watched a decision change nothing.
